problem_en: A loan of 5,46,000 is to be repaid in two equal annual installments. If the interest is compounded annually at 20% per annum, calculate the value of each installment.
problem_hi: 5,46,000 रुपये के ऋण को दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस किया जाना है। यदि ब्याज 20% वार्षिक दर से संयोजित होता है, तो प्रत्येक किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Ek loan of 5,46,000 ko repay karna hai in two equal annual installments. Agar interest annual compound ho raha hai at 20% per annum, toh har installment ki value calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Loan amount 5 lakh 46 hazaar hai jise do equal annual installments mein dena hai. Interest rate 20% p.a. hai compounded annually. Har installment kitne ki hogi?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let installment be x. Present Value (PV) of 1st installment = x/1.2.
Step 2: PV of 2nd installment = x/(1.2^2) = x/1.44.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 46 hazaar notation -> LLM may parse as 5 or 46000, missing the full 5,46,000 value.
why_hard: Requires reverse algebraic solving of the annuity present value formula with non-trivial decimals.

problem_en: A sum is borrowed at 10% p.a. compound interest and paid back in two equal annual installments of 12,100 each. Find the total interest charged in this transaction.
problem_hi: एक राशि 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार ली गई और 12,100 रुपये की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस की गई। इस लेनदेन में कुल कितना ब्याज लिया गया?
problem_hg_030: Ek sum borrow kiya 10% p.a. compound interest pe aur pay back kiya in two equal installments of 12,100 each. Pura interest kitna charge hua find karo.
problem_hg_065: 10% rate pe loan liya aur 12,100 ki do installments di, par bank ne bola ki 10 aur log aaye hain scheme mein toh process slow hai. Total interest calculate karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye -> LLM might interpret '10' as an additive factor to the rate or the principal.
why_hard: Forces the model to derive principal first and then subtract from total repayment.

problem_en: A man buys a gadget for 30,000 down payment and two equal annual installments of 33,800 each. If interest is 30% p.a. compounded annually, what was the cash price of the gadget?
problem_hi: एक आदमी ने 30,000 के डाउन पेमेंट और 33,800 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों पर एक गैजेट खरीदा। यदि ब्याज 30% वार्षिक है, तो गैजेट की नकद कीमत क्या थी?
problem_hg_030: Gadget kharida 30,000 down payment pe aur 33,800 ki do equal installments pe. Agar interest 30% p.a. hai, toh cash price kya thi?
problem_hg_065: Cash price nikaalo agar down payment 30,000 hai aur baaki amount do equal installments of 33,800 mein pay kiya at 30% compound interest.
solution_steps_en: Step 4: Cash Price = Down Payment + Principal = 30000 + 46000 = 76000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki -> LLM might ignore the subtraction logic or treat it as a remainder of the installment rather than the financed amount.
why_hard: Combines immediate cash flow (down payment) with discounted future cash flows.

problem_en: A loan of 8,200 is repaid in 2 years with equal annual installments. If the rate is 5% p.a. compounded annually, find the value of each installment.
problem_hi: 8,200 का ऋण 2 वर्षों में समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। यदि दर 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि है, तो प्रत्येक किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Loan of 8,200 repay kiya 2 years mein with equal installments. Rate 5% p.a. compounded annually hai, toh installment find karo.
problem_hg_065: Rate 5% hai par interest 6 mahine baad calculate nahi hota, saal bhar ka hai. 8,200 loan hai toh do equal installments kitni hongi?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad -> LLM may switch to semi-annual compounding formula incorrectly.
why_hard: Requires precise decimal division of a 4-digit principal over a squared growth factor.

problem_en: A sum of money is borrowed and paid back in three equal annual installments of 2,160 each at 20% p.a. compounded annually. Find the sum borrowed.
problem_hi: एक राशि उधार ली गई और 20% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 2,160 की तीन समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाई गई। उधार ली गई राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Sum borrow karke 20% interest pe pay back kiya in three equal installments of 2,160 each. Sum borrowed find karo.
problem_hg_065: Teeno installments 2,160 ki hain. Rate 20% hai aur dono ko milakar total borrow kiya gaya paisa nikaalo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko -> In a 3-installment problem, 'dono' (both/two) might lead LLM to calculate for only 2 years.
why_hard: Extends the geometric progression to three terms with increasing powers of 1.2.

problem_en: What equal annual installment will discharge a debt of 10,250 due in two years at 5% p.a. compound interest?
problem_hi: 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर दो वर्षों में 10,250 के ऋण को चुकाने के लिए समान वार्षिक किश्त क्या होगी?
problem_hg_030: Kya equal annual installment lagegi to discharge a debt of 10,250 in two years at 5% p.a. CI?
problem_hg_065: Debt 10,250 hai. Interest rate pichle saal se 20% zyada nahi balki steady 5% hai. Do equal installments calculate karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 20% zyada -> LLM might try to modify the interest rate (5% + 20% = 6% or 25%).
why_hard: Reverse EMI calculation with fractional final result.

problem_en: A loan is cleared in two equal annual installments of 8,820 each at 5% p.a. CI. Find the total interest paid.
problem_hi: एक ऋण 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 8,820 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। कुल भुगतान किया गया ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Loan clear kiya in two equal installments of 8,820 at 5% interest. Total interest paid kitna hai?
problem_hg_065: 8,820 ki do installments di hain. Pehle principal calculate karo phir total interest nikaalo. Rate 5% p.a. hai.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir -> Explicit sequencing might cause LLM to fail if it attempts to solve out of order or misses the final subtraction.
why_hard: Requires calculation of intermediate principal amount to find the interest component.

problem_en: A TV set is available for 19,650 cash or for a down payment and two equal annual installments of 10,580 each at 15% p.a. CI. Find the down payment.
problem_hi: एक टीवी सेट 19,650 नकद या कुछ डाउन पेमेंट और 15% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 10,580 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों पर उपलब्ध है। डाउन पेमेंट ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: TV set 19,650 cash ya down payment + two installments of 10,580 each at 15% rate pe mil raha hai. Down payment find karo.
problem_hg_065: TV cash price 19,650 hai. 10,580 ki do installments di hain. Baaki amount down payment tha. Rate 15% p.a. hai.
solution_steps_en: Step 4: Down Payment = Cash Price - Principal = 19650 - 17180 = 2470.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki -> Refers to the down payment in a way that suggests it's a remainder, which may confuse the Cash Price - Loan logic.
why_hard: Requires splitting the total cash price into immediate and financed components.

problem_en: Find the sum that can be repaid in two equal annual installments of 2,420 each at 10% p.a. compounded annually.
problem_hi: वह राशि ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 2,420 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जा सके।
problem_hg_030: Wo sum find karo jo two equal installments of 2,420 each at 10% p.a. CI pe clear ho jaye.
problem_hg_065: Rate na 5% se na 8% se balki 10% se calculate karna hai. 2,420 ki do installments ka principal kitna hoga?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible -> 'na 5% se na 8% se' might be parsed as complex logic constraints rather than simple exclusions.
why_hard: Standard reverse EMI but embedded in multiple linguistic distractors.

problem_en: A debt of 12,900 is paid in two equal half-yearly installments at 20% p.a. compounded semi-annually. Find each installment.
problem_hi: 12,900 का ऋण 20% वार्षिक दर (अर्धवार्षिक संयोजित) पर दो समान अर्धवार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। प्रत्येक किश्त ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 12,900 का loan two equal half-yearly installments mein pay kiya at 20% p.a. compounded semi-annually. Installment find karo.
problem_hg_065: Loan 12,900 hai. Interest rate 20% p.a. hai par installment 6 mahine baad deni hai (total 2). Value kya hogi?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad -> Confirms the timing of the first installment and the compounding frequency.
why_hard: Requires halving the annual rate and correctly applying the 2-period discount.

problem_en: A man borrowed 25,200 and promised to pay it back in 3 equal annual installments at 5% p.a. CI. Find the installment value.
problem_hi: एक आदमी ने 25,200 उधार लिए और 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 3 समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस करने का वादा किया। किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 25,200 borrow kiya aur 3 equal installments mein 5% p.a. CI pe pay karne ka promise kiya. Installment value find karo.
problem_hg_065: Principal 25,200 hai. Teeno installments ko dono ko dhyan mein rakh kar 5% p.a. par divide karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko -> In a 3-installment problem, 'dono' is a linguistic trap to check if LLM ignores the '3' from the previous sentence.
why_hard: Solving for a high-precision EMI across three years.

problem_en: A loan is repaid in 2 years with installments of 6,760 each at 4% p.a. CI. Find the principal.
problem_hi: एक ऋण 4% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 6,760 की दो किश्तों में 2 वर्षों में चुकाया जाता है। मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Loan repay kiya in 2 years with installments of 6,760 each at 4% p.a. CI. Principal find karo.
problem_hg_065: Har installment 6,760 ki hai at 4% interest rate. Withdraw kar liya N mahine baad wala koi scene nahi hai, bas principal batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad -> Complex distractor suggesting a mid-term withdrawal that didn't happen.
why_hard: Tests the model's ability to filter out complex irrelevant transactional narratives.

problem_en: Find the installment to discharge a debt of 3,310 in 3 years at 10% p.a. CI.
problem_hi: 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 3 वर्षों में 3,310 के ऋण को चुकाने के लिए किश्त ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Installment find karo to discharge a debt of 3,310 in 3 years at 10% p.a. CI.
problem_hg_065: Debt total 3,310 hai. Teeno installments mein 10 aur log aaye scheme ke hisab se nahi, 10% rate se payment karni hai.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye -> LLM might mistake '10' for the number of installments or rate change.
why_hard: Three-step present value summation requiring common denominator calculation.

problem_en: A sum of 16,224 is borrowed at 4% p.a. CI and paid back in two equal installments. Find each installment.
problem_hi: 16,224 की राशि 4% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार ली गई और दो समान किश्तों में वापस की गई। प्रत्येक किश्त ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Sum of 16,224 borrow kiya at 4% rate and paid back in 2 installments. Each installment find karo.
problem_hg_065: 16,224 borrow kiya hai. Rate A se 20% zyada nahi, flat 4% hai. Do equal installments kitni hongi?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada -> Directional trap suggesting the rate should be compared or adjusted relative to a variable 'A'.
why_hard: Requires precise division by 2.04 and multiplication by 1.0816.

problem_en: A loan of 6,600 is to be paid in two equal annual installments at 10% p.a. CI. Find the value of each installment.
problem_hi: 6,600 के ऋण को 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाना है। प्रत्येक किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Loan of 6,600 repay karna hai in two equal annual installments at 10% interest. Each installment calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: 6 hazaar 600 ka loan hai. Pehle installments ka logic lagao phir 10% CI apply karo. Do equal installments kya hongi?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 hazaar 600 -> Number notation trap; 'pehle...phir' trap suggests a wrong order of operations.
why_hard: Testing parsing of Hindi number names and sensitivity to operation sequencing instructions.
